messages.subject: Ledgerly cutover - confirmed plan, Monday 6 July
messages.body:
Helen, Jonas,

Confirmed plan, as agreed yesterday and now fixed:

- Cutover: Monday 6 July, first live Ledgerly settlement cycle starts that day
- 29-30 June: final PayForge billing run, June books close on a single provider
- 1-3 July: production config freeze, final ledgerly prod checks, dry run of the reconciliation job against the closed June ledger
- 6 July: switch billing service to Ledgerly, PayForge moves to read-only
- PayForge notice: 30 days, so I will send termination on 6 July; contract ends 5 August. Helen, that answers your minimum-fee question - no overlap beyond the notice we must honour.
- Aisha: customer comms draft due 10 July, statement-name change flagged two weeks ahead per her request

Rollback: PayForge stays live in read-only until 5 August, so we can fail back within one working day if a settlement misbehaves.

Cheers, Dev

messages.subject: RE: Ledgerly cutover - confirmed plan, Monday 6 July
messages.body:
plan looks right. one thing: the 1-3 july dry run needs the june ledger fully closed, and last month's close slipped two days because of the v3 rollout. can we make the ledger close a hard dependency, i'll put an alert on it.

also maya's team owes us the gross refund line config in prod - i'll chase them this week.

messages.subject: RE: Ledgerly cutover - confirmed plan, Monday 6 July
messages.body:
Dear Dev,

Thank you, this is exactly the level of detail I needed, and I am pleased to see the PayForge termination handled so that we do not pay a single avoidable day of overlap. I will make sure the June close is completed by 30 June even if I have to sit with the books myself on the 30th - Jonas, your alert idea has my full support.

With a fixed date of Monday 6 July I can now commit the approximately €1,860 monthly saving in the July forecast. I would gently suggest we treat this date as immovable.

Kind regards,
Helen Oyelaran
Chief Financial Officer, Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Ledgerly cutover - confirmed plan, Monday 6 July
messages.body:
good. 6 july it is. nobody moves it again, not helen's forecast, not dev's dry run, not anything else. thanks all.

M
Sent from my iPhone
